items.title: SvelteKit: adapter-node crashes with an unhandled URIError when `reroute` rewrites malformed pathnames
items.summary: When `reroute` turned an invalid percent-encoded path into a valid path, it could potentially trigger a comparison that would crash the server.

items.title: SvelteKit: Prerendered paths are interpreted as regular expressions in Vercel route config generated by @sveltejs/adapter-vercel and @sveltejs/adapter-static
items.summary: If an attacker could influence a link that was crawled during the prerender phase, that link could later be interpreted as a regex in the Vercel routing configuration.

items.title: SvelteKit: Prerendered redirect paths can inject arbitrary rules into the `_redirects` file generated by `@sveltejs/adapter-cloudflare`
items.summary: If an attacker can influence the links crawled during prerendering, they can influence the redirects entries that are added to the Cloudflare platform redirects generated during the adapt phase of the build.

items.title: SvelteKit: `@sveltejs/adapter-node` crashes when proxying certain requests via `fetch`
items.summary: In affected versions, `@sveltejs/adapter-node` can attempt to add a header to an immutable request in a context that causes the server to crash, denying service to any other requests routed to that server.

items.title: Tornado: Open redirect via triple-slash redirect paths
items.summary: ### Summary Due to differences in the way browsers and Python's `urllib` parse urls, browsers treat a string starting with three or more slashes as a protocol-level redirect, while `urllib` does not. This means that the 6.6.0 fix for the RedirectHandler open redirect (CVE-2026-116578, commit cc75ab0e) is incomplete. Tornado 6.6.1 improves the open-redirect detection to handle this case correctly, as well as fixing a regression in the 6.6.0 implementation.

items.title: dnspython has excessive memory and CPU use

It then uses this number to resize the bitmap to accommodate a bit with that offset. items.summary: ### Summary Since `4.6.0`, Nuxt parses a request path that starts with `//` as a URL with a host before rendering a page, so `//x/admin` renders the page at `/admin`. items.title: sqlite3-ruby: Possible SQL query truncation when a string is 4 GiB or larger
items.summary: ### Summary sqlite3-ruby cast Ruby string lengths (`long`) to `int` before passing them to SQLite. An attacker who controls the length of a SQL string could truncate the query, for example dropping a trailing `WHERE` clause. items.title: Astro: Image endpoint in @astrojs/node can read files from a case-variant sibling of the output directory on case-sensitive filesystems

items.summary: ## Summary `Rails::HTML::SafeListSanitizer` (both the HTML4 and HTML5 variants) shares one `Rails::HTML::PermitScrubber` across every `sanitize` call on the same instance, assigning its `tags` and `attributes` on each call without synchronization. items.title: rails-html-sanitizer: Possible regular expression denial of service with certain configurations
items.summary: ## Summary `Rails::HTML::PermitScrubber` restricts the `href` and `xlink:href` attributes of SVG reference elements to local references. That check matched the attribute value against `/^\s*[^#\s].*/m`.
